qsub.txt.what: qsub stdout for a plain job

qsub_array.txt.what: qsub stdout for an array job

qacct_ok.txt.what: qacct -j of a job that exited 0

qacct_exit1.txt.what: qacct -j of a job that exited 1

qacct_array_task.txt.what: qacct -j <id> -t 2 of a finished array (task 2 exited 0)

qacct_array_base.txt.what: qacct -j <id> of a finished three-task array: one record per task, task 3 exited 1

qacct_skipped.txt.what: qacct -j of a job that exited 113 (the dependency guard's skip code)

qacct_owner_bob.txt.what: qacct -j -o bob -b <since>: bob's records then the owner summary block (BUG-T2)

qacct_vmem.txt.what: qacct -j of a 200 MB allocation under h_vmem=50M (failed 0, non-zero exit)

qdel_pending.txt.what: qdel stdout for a job that never ran

qacct_deleted_pending.txt.what: qacct -j of a job deleted while pending: no record is ever written (JSON)

qacct_signal.txt.what: qacct -j of a running job deleted with qdel (exit_status 137 (Killed), BUG-T5)

qacct_timeout.txt.what: qacct -j of a short.q job killed at h_rt (failed 37, exit_status 137)

qacct_lost_node.txt.what: qacct -j of a job whose node was killed (failed 19, BUG-T3)

qstat_lifecycle.txt.what: plain qstat -u '*' of the same moment

qdel_deleting.txt.what: qdel stdout when execd is away

qstat_deleting.xml.what: qstat -xml -u '*' with a deleted job still in dr (its node paused)

qacct_requeued.txt.what: qacct -j of a rescheduled job: failed 25 (rescheduling), then its end (qdel)

qstat_transient.xml.what: qstat -xml -u '*': threshold-suspended (T), requeued waiting (Rq), deleted while transferring (dt)

qstat_transient.txt.what: plain qstat -u '*' of the same moment

qstat_mixed.xml.what: qstat -xml -u '*': running, hqw (user hold, -hold_jid), Eqw, array with r and qw

qstat_mixed.txt.what: plain qstat -u '*' of the same moment

qstat_j_missing.txt.what: qstat -j of an unknown id (JSON: returncode, stdout, stderr)

qstat_master_down.json.what: qstat -xml -u '*' with the qmaster stopped (JSON, BUG-T6)
